product_overview: admin_vue3_vite is an enterprise-grade Vue 3 backend admin template that provides login authentication, RBAC permission management, dynamic navigation, and reusable UI demos out of the box. It is designed as a reusable foundation for building internal management systems and learning common backend application patterns.
core_goals: Sign in with username, password, and captcha to access the admin system
Navigate through a dynamic layout with sidebar, breadcrumbs, and tag-based page history
Manage permissions through role, account, and permission list views
Use built-in editors and UI demos to validate reusable frontend components
Explore CSS animation and VueUse examples as implementation references for common frontend effects

features.name: 用户登录
features.description: Authenticate with username, password, and a visual captcha shown as plain text on the login page, then enter the system after successful validation.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> View the displayed 4-character captcha text -> Enter the username -> Enter the password -> Enter the captcha exactly as shown -> Submit the login form -> See the home page
Navigate to /login -> Enter a password shorter than 6 characters -> Submit the login form -> See the password validation message
Navigate to /login -> Enter an incorrect captcha -> Submit the login form -> See the captcha error message
Navigate to /login -> Toggle password visibility -> Observe the password switch between hidden and visible

features.name: 退出登录
features.description: Allow a signed-in user to end the session from the top-right user menu and return to the login page.
user_flows: Navigate to /home -> Open the user menu -> Choose logout -> See the login page

features.name: 布局与导航
features.description: Provide the main admin shell with sidebar navigation, breadcrumb context, tag-based page history, full-screen mode, and the guided walkthrough entry point.
user_flows: Navigate to /home -> Use the sidebar to open another page -> See the selected page load in the content area
Navigate to /home -> Open a previously visited tag -> See that page become active
Navigate to /home -> Close a tag -> See the corresponding page removed from the tag list
Navigate to /home -> Toggle full-screen mode -> Observe the interface switch between windowed and full-screen display
Navigate to /home -> Start the guided walkthrough -> See the feature introduction steps appear

features.name: 角色列表
features.description: Display a table of roles and let the user open a permission assignment dialog to configure role permissions.
user_flows: Navigate to /adminAuth/getRoleList -> View the role table -> Open the permission assignment dialog for a role -> Select permission nodes in the tree -> Save the selection and return to the table
Navigate to /adminAuth/getRoleList -> View the role table -> Expand and collapse permission nodes in the assignment tree -> Observe the tree hierarchy

features.name: 账号列表
features.description: Display account data and support viewing account details, assigning roles, deleting accounts with confirmation, and importing accounts from Excel.
user_flows: Navigate to /adminAuth/adminList -> View the account table -> Open an account's details -> See the account detail page
Navigate to /adminAuth/adminList -> View the account table -> Open the role assignment dialog for an account -> Select a role -> Confirm the assignment
Navigate to /adminAuth/adminList -> View the account table -> Start account deletion -> Confirm the deletion in the confirmation dialog -> See the account removed from the list
Navigate to /adminAuth/adminList -> Open the Excel import dialog -> Download the template if needed -> Choose an Excel file -> Import the file

features.name: 权限列表
features.description: Show the permission tree and permission details so users can inspect the application’s menu and button structure.
user_flows: Navigate to /adminAuth/permissionList -> View the permission tree table -> Expand a permission node -> See its nested children
Navigate to /adminAuth/permissionList -> View the permission tree table -> Collapse a permission node -> See the tree fold back

features.name: 富文本编辑器
features.description: Provide a WYSIWYG editor for composing formatted content and previewing the result.
user_flows: Navigate to /third/editor -> Enter content in the editor -> Apply formatting from the toolbar -> Observe the formatted text in the document

features.name: Markdown 编辑器
features.description: Provide a Markdown editor with live preview for writing and validating Markdown content.
user_flows: Navigate to /third/markdown -> Enter Markdown text -> Observe the live preview update alongside the source content

features.name: CSS 动画示例
features.description: Offer a set of animation demo pages for exploring reusable CSS and DOM motion effects.
user_flows: Navigate to /cssAnimation/shootingStar -> View the shooting star animation
Navigate to /cssAnimation/jumpBlock -> View the jumping icon animation
Navigate to /cssAnimation/downBtn -> View the animated download button effect
Navigate to /cssAnimation/tabs -> Select a tab -> Observe the animated tab transition
Navigate to /cssAnimation/clock -> View the clock animation

features.name: vueUse 示例
features.description: Demonstrate common VueUse composables such as dragging, drop zones, and intersection observation.
user_flows: Navigate to /elements/useDraggable -> Drag the element -> Observe its position change
Navigate to /elements/useDraggable -> Drag the element -> Observe the updated coordinates
Navigate to /elements/useDropZone -> Drop a supported item into the drop area -> Observe the drop zone response
Navigate to /elements/useIntersectionObserver -> Scroll until the target intersects the viewport -> Observe the intersection state change

known_limitations.issue: 登录验证码是 mock 接口返回的随机4位字符，以纯文本显示在页面 code-img 区域，自动化测试必须先读取该文本再输入
known_limitations.impact: 不输入与页面显示一致的验证码会提示"验证码错误！"，无法登录

known_limitations.issue: 所有后端接口均由 vite-plugin-mock 本地 mock（需 vite.config.js 中 enable:true），无真实后端
known_limitations.impact: CRUD 操作不会持久化，仅返回固定 mock 数据

known_limitations.issue: 音频可视化菜单（/audio/canvas、/audio/wavesurfer）在权限 mock 数据中返回，但路由模块未注册
/cssAnimation/clock 与 /cssAnimation/tabs 路由 name 重复（均为 tabs）
known_limitations.impact: resetRouter 按 name 删除路由时可能删错

known_limitations.issue: mock 的 getRoleList 接口返回的 page_info.total_items 为 2，但实际 obj 有 6 条数据
known_limitations.impact: 分页总数显示与实际数据不一致
